description: Solelproduktionsdata Uppsala Buss Verkstad 2019-2021, 5 min upplösning is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by STUNS Energi. Solar power production data from appointed solar power plant at Region Uppsala. The production data is presented in 5 minute resolution. The data collection has a higher resolution. Contact STUNS if higher resolution is required, see contact. Coverage: a solar power plant at Region Uppsala. The portal shows the English title as "Solar production data Uppsala Buss Service Shop 2019-2021, 5min res" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is STUNS Energi. Its keywords include high resolution, solelanläggningar, högupplöst, Region Uppsala, STUNS Energi, Solar production. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution–NonCommercial 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
